title: Single-exponential recovery and bounded-price strictness for metric k-median
summary: We give an exact-budget recovery algorithm for metric k -median with single-exponential dependence on the number of comparison clusters without accurate, distinct proxies in a supplied anchor solution. On positive integral metrics of polynomially bounded diameter, a sufficiently small total proxy error and logarithmically many such clusters yield a $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$ approximation in polynomial time with arbitrarily high success probability.
